name: Shoko Image Planner
overview: Assign distinct images to series within each top-level Shoko group.

releases.release_notes:
## Shoko Image Planner 1.0.0

Portable `any` plugin archive. Add this repository to Shoko with:

`https://github.com/crowquillx/shoko-image-manager/releases/latest/download/manifest.json`

### Changes

- 8339d2e feat: add Shoko Image Planner plugin
### Artifacts

- `Shoko.ImagePlanner-1.0.0-any.zip` — plugin archive
- `manifest.json` — Shoko repository manifest

## Shoko Image Planner 1.0.1

Portable `any` plugin archive. Add this repository to Shoko with:

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crowquillx/shoko-image-manager/metadata/manifest.json`

The persistent metadata feed is updated on the `metadata` branch after this release.

### Changes

- c40f93e fix(api): expose planner routes and settings
- 6471107 fix(release): publish a Shoko-compatible manifest feed
### Artifacts

- `Shoko.ImagePlanner-1.0.1-any.zip` — plugin archive
- `manifest.json` — Shoko repository manifest
